files.purpose: Workflow-only trusted projection generator and mechanical seed validator using CSPRNG
GitHub Actions automation handling selection, projection generation, verification, and loop suppression
files.content:
name: Truth Reader Challenge

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'truth-reader/selector.json'
      - 'truth-reader/evidence.json'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  evaluate:
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && github.actor != 'Truth-Reader-Bot[bot]'"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Determine Trigger Mode
        id: detect
        run: |
          git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD > modified_files.txt
          cat modified_files.txt
          if grep -q '^truth-reader/evidence.json$' modified_files.txt; then
            echo "mode=verify" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif grep -q '^truth-reader/selector.json$' modified_files.txt; then
            echo "mode=generate" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "mode=none" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Generate Reading Projections
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'generate'
        run: |
          node .github/scripts/truth-reader-engine.js generate
          git config user.name 'Truth-Reader-Bot[bot]'
          git config user.email 'truth-reader@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add truth-reader/projections/ .github/workflow-state.json || true
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): publish seeded reading projections [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

      - name: Verify Submitted Evidence
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'verify'
        run: |
          # Verification fails closed: on failure, process exits non-zero, zero mutations occur.
          node .github/scripts/truth-reader-engine.js verify
          git config user.name 'Truth-Reader-Bot[bot]'
          git config user.email 'truth-reader@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add truth-reader/selector.json truth-reader/evidence.json truth-reader/status.json truth-reader/projections/ .github/workflow-state.json || true
          git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): atomic pass reset and evidence cleanup [skip ci]"
          git push

# Agent Roles and Boundaries

## GeminiSupervisor
The GeminiSupervisor acts as an independent authoritative evaluator. It monitors model actions against explicit policy constraints.

## Worker Agents
Worker agents process assigned tasks, inspect reading projections, and produce cryptographically verifiable evidence.

## Truth Reading Boundary
Authoritative documentation cannot be modified or truncated during evaluation runs. Ephemeral JSON reading projections provide full fidelity representations.

files.content:
# Truth Reader Architecture

## Overview
This repository implements an automated workflow truth-reading challenge. Authoritative documents remain untouched while full-fidelity ephemeral reading projections are generated on demand.

## Challenge Flow
1. Select document IDs via enumerated booleans in `truth-reader/selector.json`.
2. The workflow generates JSON projections with distributed CSPRNG seeds.
3. Worker reads projections and submits the ordered seed vector into `truth-reader/evidence.json`.
4. The workflow mechanically verifies the seeds. A match results in an atomic reset and PASS status; a mismatch results in zero repository mutations.

# Repository Manifest

- `truth-reader/catalog.json`: Document catalog with stable IDs.
- `truth-reader/selector.json`: Boolean selector interface.
- `truth-reader/evidence.json`: Evidence submission interface.
- `truth-reader/status.json`: Persisted pass/idle status.
- `.github/scripts/truth-reader-engine.js`: Projection and verification engine.
- `.github/workflows/truth-reader.yml`: Workflow trigger with recursion guard.
